newsitem.title: USA: Medical Industries has 1.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Medical Industries has 1.5 mln shares.

text.p: Medical Industries of America Inc on Monday said it had 1.5 million shares of common stock outstanding after a recent rights offering.

Under the offering, the company's shareholders exercised conversion rights available on 50 percent of the company's Series D convertible preferred shares. The remaining 50 percent will be eligible for conversion on February 2, the company said.
The offering resulted in about 300,000 new shares being issued, the company added. The company had 1.2 million before the offering.
The company's shares last traded at 1-3/8.
